small_guidance:
- Add larger BLOCK_M tiles (e.g. 128/256 with BLOCK_K=16, num_warps=8) and a BLOCK_M=32, BLOCK_K=64 variant; current OS=30·62·62=115320 means BLOCK_M=128/256 gives much better occupancy than 64. Also try num_stages=3 with the small (32,32) tile.
- Move the `pid_b` to the inner grid axis (swap grid order to `(N, cdiv(OS, BLOCK_M))`) so consecutive programs share weight tiles in L2; weights are reloaded N=64 times per spatial tile today.
- Hoist the `_weight_flat`, `conv_bias`, and `bias_flat` `.cuda().contiguous()` calls into `__init__` (store as buffers/parameters already on CUDA) so `forward` does no per-call host work; also drop the redundant `BLOCK_N` arg by hardcoding `BLOCK_N=32` (OC=32 exactly) to let the compiler specialize.
large_guidance:
- Restructure as a persistent/output-stationary kernel tiled on `(N, OC, OD, OH, OW)` with channels_last (NDHWC) input layout so the GEMM-K axis (IC·KD·KH·KW=216) is contiguous; this eliminates the strided gather across IC and lets `tl.dot` consume vector loads directly.
- Since K_TOT=216 is small and fixed, fully unroll the KD/KH/KW loops as `constexpr` triple-nested and only loop over IC in chunks of BLOCK_K=8 or 16; this removes the modulo/division index math currently computed every K iteration.
- Consider a 2D spatial tile (e.g. BLOCK_OH×BLOCK_OW = 8×16) per program with OC fully resident (BLOCK_N=32) so input rows for a (oh,ow) tile are reused across all 27 kernel offsets; current 1D flattened OS tile loses spatial reuse of the input halo.
